7-Day Southern Morocco Tour: Kasbahs & Desert Valleys
summary:
The 7-Day Morocco Coach Tour follows a small-group circuit from Marrakech into the country’s southern valleys and desert regions. Travel across the Atlas Mountains toward Ouarzazate, then continue through Zagora and Tazzarine to Erfoud before reaching Tinghir. The route focuses on southern Morocco, where kasbah architecture, oasis settlements and changing mountain-to-desert landscapes give the journey a character distinct from the country’s imperial-city tours.
Guaranteed departures operate every Tuesday throughout the year, with deluxe coach transportation used along the route. The seven-day program includes selected hotels with breakfast, guided sightseeing, airport transfers, entrance fees and porterage services, all arranged within the scheduled small-group format.

itinerary.title: Tueasday: Arrival in Marrakech
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Marrakech Menara Airport and meet with our representative. Transfer to your hotel in Marrakech.
Hotel check-in after 14:00pm. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Marrakech.

itinerary.title: Wednasday: Visiting Marrakech
itinerary.text: Full-day tour of Marrakech. Visit the Menara Gardens, Saadian Tombs, Bahia Palace, Koutoubia Mosque, and Dar Si Said Museum. Lunch at the hotel. Explore the traditional souks and handicraft quarters before visiting the famous Jemaa el-Fnaa square with its lively entertainment. Optional traditional dinner and folkloric show at Chez Ali. Overnight in Marrakech

itinerary.title: Thursday: Ouarzazate to Zagora (380km)
itinerary.text: Drive through the Tizi n'Tichka mountain pass (2,260m altitude). Visit Aït Benhaddou, a UNESCO World Heritage site and famous film location. Optional lunch at a local restaurant overlooking the Kasbah. Continue through the scenic Draa Valley before arriving in Zagora or the surrounding area depending.

itinerary.title: Friday: Nkob, Tazzarine and Erfoud (360km)
itinerary.text:
Drive to Tamegroute and visit the pottery center
Optional visit of the historic Quranic library (subject to availability)
Continue through Tansikht and Nkob with scenic views of the Saghro Mountains
Optional lunch in Tazzarine, a traditional Berber village
Continue via Alnif and Rissani, birthplace of the Alaouite Dynasty
Optional 4x4 excursion to the Erg Chebbi dunes for dinner and overnight in a Berber desert camp (bivouac)
Overnight in Erfoud or desert camp depending on selected option

itinerary.title: Saturday: Tinghir and Ouarzazate (375km)
itinerary.text:
Optional early morning 4x4 excursion to Erg Chebbi to watch the sunrise over the dunes
Drive to Tinghir and visit the spectacular Todra Gorge (up to 250m cliffs)
Optional lunch at a local restaurant at the foot of the canyons
Continue through the Road of the Thousand Kasbahs via Kelaat Mgouna and Skoura
Arrive in Ouarzazate Overnight in Ouarzazate

itinerary.title: Sunday: Ouarzazate to Marrakech (210km)
itinerary.text: Breakfast, followed by an orientation city tour. Drive back to Marrakech. Optional lunch at a local restaurant upon arrival. Free afternoon at leisure for last sightseeing in Marrakech. Overnight in Marrakech.

itinerary.title: Monday: Transfer to Marrakech Airport
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel in Marrakech
Transfer to Marrakech Menara Airport for your international flight departure

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 7-Day Morocco Coach Tour?
faqs.a: The 7-Day Morocco Coach Tour covers Marrakech, Nkob, Tinghir, and Ouarzazate. This exciting journey takes travelers through the Atlas Mountains, traditional Berber villages, dramatic desert landscapes, scenic valleys, and historic kasbahs, showcasing some of Morocco's most beautiful regions. The tour runs for 6 nights and 7 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 7-Day Morocco Coach Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,395 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, private land transportation, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, and transfers according to the itinerary. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and accommodation category.

faqs.q: Is transportation included throughout the tour?
faqs.a: Yes, private land transportation is included throughout the entire itinerary. Comfortable vehicles are used for all transfers and sightseeing, ensuring a smooth and enjoyable travel experience across Morocco.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels, traditional riads, and guesthouses with daily breakfast. Properties are chosen for their comfort, service quality, and authentic Moroccan atmosphere.

faqs.q: Does the tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides accompany the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guide will provide valuable insights into Morocco's history, culture, architecture, and local traditions throughout the journey.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Morocco?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for travelers seeking a deeper exploration of Morocco beyond the major cities. It combines cultural experiences, mountain scenery, desert landscapes, and traditional villages in a memorable itinerary.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy to moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through historic sites, valleys, villages, and desert areas. Most visitors with average fitness levels can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Marrakech, Nkob, Tinghir, and Ouarzazate?
faqs.a: Marrakech is famous for its colorful souks, palaces, gardens, and vibrant atmosphere. Nkob is known for its traditional kasbahs and beautiful desert surroundings. Tinghir offers stunning oasis scenery and access to the spectacular Todra Gorge. Ouarzazate is renowned for its historic kasbahs, cinematic landscapes, and famous film studios.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 7-Day Morocco Coach Tour?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the 7-Day Morocco Coach Tour be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade accommodations, include a Sahara Desert camp experience, or modify the itinerary to suit your interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
